title: High Churn, Higher Charges Customers
description: This cluster represents customers with a strong propensity to churn, indicated by a high deviation in 'Churn Label_Yes' and a significant portion of missing churn reasons. These customers also tend to have higher monthly and total charges.  They are less likely to have internet-related services like Tech Support, Streaming TV, Online Backup, and Online Security, suggesting dissatisfaction with core offerings.

title: High Churn Risk, Fiber Optic Customers
description: This cluster represents customers with a high likelihood of churning, indicated by a significantly positive Churn Label and Churn Value. These customers are also more likely to have fiber optic internet service and month-to-month contracts. They tend to lack online security and tech support, alongside higher monthly charges.

title: No Internet Service, Low Charges
description: This cluster represents customers with no internet service across various related features like online security and tech support. These customers also tend to have lower monthly charges compared to the global average. It highlights a segment distinctly lacking internet connectivity and opting for lower-cost plans.

title: No Phone, DSL Internet Customers
description: This cluster represents customers who exclusively use phone service and DSL internet. They do not have multiple phone lines or fiber optic internet. Monthly charges are lower than average.
